playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs
  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
  localstorage-set <key> <value> set a localstorage item
  localstorage-delete <key>   delete a localstorage item
  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-body <index>       print the response body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command. textual bodies are inlined; binary bodies are saved to a file and the path is printed.
  route <pattern>             mock network requests matching a url pattern
  route-list                  list all active network routes
  unroute [pattern]           remove routes matching a pattern (or all routes)
  network-state-set <state>   set the browser network state to online or offline

DevTools:
  console [min-level]         list console messages
  run-code [code]             run playwright code snippet
  recording-start             start recording user actions
  recording-stop              stop recording user actions and print them as playwright code
  tracing-start               start trace recording
  tracing-stop                stop trace recording
  video-start [filename]      start video recording
  video-stop                  stop video recording
  video-chapter <title>       add a chapter marker to the video recording
  video-show-actions          annotate subsequent cli/mcp actions on the page with a callout that names the action and highlights the target element
  video-hide-actions          stop annotating actions performed on the page
  show                        show playwright dashboard
  pause-at <location>         run the test up to a specific location and pause there
  resume                      resume the test execution
  step-over                   step over the next call in the test
  generate-locator <target>   generate a playwright locator for the given element
  highlight [target]          show (or with --hide, remove) a highlight overlay for an element; `--hide` without a target hides all page highlights.

Install:
  install                     initialize workspace
  install-browser [browser]   install browser

Browser sessions:
  list                        list browser sessions
  close-all                   close all browser sessions
  kill-all                    forcefully kill all browser sessions (for stale/zombie processes)

<subagent sessionID="ses_e4eabfee5ffe8J5FmcmT24UhWu" state="completed">
## Findings

- **`playerMaxHealth` appears to be undefined.** The only reference in `game.js` is `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:834`, where `resetRun()` calls `playerMaxHealth()`. No definition appears elsewhere in the repository. `init()` calls `resetRun()` at startup, and the Start/Retry buttons call it too, so this missing function would throw a `ReferenceError` and interrupt startup or a new run.

- **Chapter/map progression:** In `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:340-355`, the world is a fixed `3000 × 2200` map with six chapter names; `CHAPTER_NIGHTS` is 8. After each eighth survived night, `beginNextDay()` calls `advanceChapter()` (`:1296-1298`). Advancing updates the chapter (capped at VI), resets haunt on shelters that have not collapsed, clears breach flags, and may randomly collapse an eligible shelter while more than four remain (`:1306-1329`). Chapter changes also update the displayed map title and scale night difficulty. The inspected progression logic does not generate a new region or change the world dimensions.

- **Menu and screen visibility:** Screens use the `.hidden` class, which sets them invisible and disables pointer events (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css:1254-1267`). The menu is initially unhidden in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:183`; `init()` keeps it visible while hiding the other screens and removing the HUD’s visible state (`game.js:3551-3561`). Start hides all screens and shows the HUD; pause, dawn, and game-over screens are shown/hidden by their respective flows. Escape/P toggles pause, and switching away from the page pauses active play. I found no menu close/minimize control or binding; the menu’s available start paths are the Start button and Enter.
</subagent>

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game and verify it in a browser, including a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, `capture.sh`, and `README.md`; no implementation changes have been made.

### Active
- Fix and verify startup/runtime issues, then implement the requested gameplay, visual/detail, menu, and mobile improvements.
- Verify desktop and mobile behavior in a browser, including boss/chapter progression and shelter interactions.
- Capture and inspect the JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Resolve and verify the startup error `ReferenceError: playerMaxHealth is not defined` at `game.js:834`.
2. Implement the seventh-night boss, chapter transition with a new regional map, shelter interactions, and requested presentation/mobile improvements.
3. Test gameplay and responsive behavior in a browser, then capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture helper.

## Important Context
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `CHAPTERS` contains six regions. `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`; there is no dedicated boss.
- `resetRun()` calls undefined `playerMaxHealth()` at `game.js:834`; browser startup has not yet been reverified.

## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game and verify it in a browser, including a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `README.md`; no implementation changes have been made.

### Active
- Fix and verify startup/runtime issues, then implement the requested gameplay, visual/detail, menu, and mobile improvements.
- Verify desktop and mobile behavior in a browser, including boss/chapter progression and shelter interactions.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Resolve and verify the startup error `ReferenceError: playerMaxHealth is not defined` at `game.js:834`.
2. Implement the seventh-night boss, chapter transition with a new regional map, shelter interactions, and requested presentation/mobile improvements.
3. Test gameplay and responsive behavior in a browser, then capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture helper.

## Important Context
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `CHAPTERS` contains six regions. `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`; there is no dedicated boss.
- `resetRun()` calls undefined `playerMaxHealth()` at `game.js:834`; browser startup has not yet been reverified.

3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

content.text:
<subagent sessionID="ses_e4ea8a2d1ffeLK9lzCUTMh0S9S" state="completed">
## Findings

1. **Advertised abilities and field kit are not wired up.** The menu advertises **C** for the field kit, **1–4** for spells, **Q** for rally, **T** for turret, and **B** for barrier ([`index.html:197–207`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html#L197)). But the keyboard handler handles E, R, Space, pause, and menu actions; other keys are merely added to the movement-key set, which only reads movement keys ([`game.js:1019–1042`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1019), [`game.js:1390–1399`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1390)). The ability definitions exist, but the code search found no ability execution or field-kit screen/tab handlers; the screen and close button are only referenced in DOM setup ([`game.js:421–442`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L421), [`game.js:110–112`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L110), [`index.html:218–249`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html#L218)). **Effect:** players cannot use several advertised actions, and the field-kit UI appears inaccessible and nonfunctional.

2. **Ranged enemies can target companions, but their projectiles only hit the player.** Enemy targeting selects companions, including shelter residents ([`game.js:1981–2009`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1981)); ranged enemies then fire at the selected target ([`game.js:2068–2070`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L2068)). However, projectile collision checks only the player and calls `damagePlayer` ([`game.js:1948–1965`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1948)). Melee enemies do damage companions, confirming that this is a mismatch in ranged combat ([`game.js:2081–2088`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L2081)). **Effect:** ranged attacks aimed at companions do not damage them.

3. **Mobile users have fewer controls, with no touch route to the advertised abilities or kit.** The touch UI provides a joystick and only USE/FIRE buttons ([`index.html:167–175`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html#L167)); the handlers implement movement, firing, and interaction only ([`game.js:1065–1099`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1065)). Responsive CSS adjusts the team panel but adds no ability or kit controls ([`styles.css:2440–2498`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css#L2440)). In touch mode, CSS also hides the weapon box that contains the control hint ([`styles.css:2440–2443`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css#L2440), [`index.html:77–80`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html#L77)). **Effect:** touch players lack visible control guidance and have no on-screen way to access the advertised kit or abilities.

4. **Chapter advancement continues after the chapter list is exhausted.** Advancement is triggered every eight survived nights ([`game.js:1296–1299`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1296)). The chapter number is capped at the list length, but the function still runs its chapter effects and selects a title using the capped chapter number ([`game.js:1306–1328`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1306); six titles are defined at [`game.js:348–355`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L348)). **Effect:** beyond chapter VI, the game can repeatedly announce the same chapter and continue applying chapter-advance effects, including shelter collapse when eligible.
</subagent>

- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game and verify it in a browser, including a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Read `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, `README.md`, and `capture.sh`; no implementation changes have been made.

### Active
- Fix and verify startup/runtime issues, including `ReferenceError: playerMaxHealth is not defined` at `game.js:834`.
- Implement the requested gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile play and chapter progression in a browser; capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call and verify startup.
2. Implement the requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test gameplay and responsive behavior in a browser, then capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture helper.

## Important Context
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `CHAPTERS` contains six regions. `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`; there is no dedicated boss.
- `resetRun()` calls undefined `playerMaxHealth()` at `game.js:834`.
- Chapter advancement continues after the chapter list is exhausted; field-kit and advertised ability controls appear unwired.

## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify gameplay in a browser with a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the requested screenshot.

## Decisions
- No new implementation decisions recorded.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, `README.md`, and `capture.sh`; no implementation changes have been made.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues, including the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
- Implement the requested gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify gameplay, responsiveness, and chapter progression in a browser; capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call and confirm the game starts.
2. Implement the requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture helper.

## Important Context
- `resetRun()` calls undefined `playerMaxHealth()` after setting `game.maxHealth = 100`; this is the known startup failure.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit and advertised ability controls appear unwired.

## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify gameplay in a browser with a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the requested screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, `capture.sh`, and `README.md`; no implementation changes made.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues, including the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
- Implement the requested gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call and confirm the game starts.
2. Implement the requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture helper.

## Important Context
- `resetRun()` sets `game.maxHealth = 100` and then calls undefined `playerMaxHealth()`.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit and advertised ability controls appear unwired.

## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify gameplay in a browser with a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the requested screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, `capture.sh`, and `README.md`; no implementation changes made.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues, including the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
- Implement the requested gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call and confirm the game starts.
2. Implement the requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture helper.

## Important Context
- `resetRun()` sets `game.maxHealth = 100` and then calls undefined `playerMaxHealth()`.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit and advertised ability controls appear unwired.
- No source changes have been made; `git status --short` was empty at inspection.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify it in a browser with a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the requested screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, `capture.sh`, and `README.md`; no implementation changes made.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues, including the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
- Implement the requested gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call and confirm the game starts.
2. Implement the requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture helper.

## Important Context
- `resetRun()` sets `game.maxHealth = 100` and then calls undefined `playerMaxHealth()`.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit and advertised ability controls appear unwired.
- Repository was clean at inspection; no source changes have been made.

## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify it in a browser with a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the requested screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `capture.sh`; no implementation changes made.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues, including the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
- Implement the requested gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call and confirm the game starts.
2. Implement the requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture helper.

## Important Context
- `resetRun()` sets `game.maxHealth = 100` and then calls `playerMaxHealth()`, which appears undefined.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit and advertised ability controls appear unwired.
- Repository was clean at inspection; no source changes have been made.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e4e996c99ffeEVEYz054cbjpsu" state="completed">
## Architecture

- **Single-file, dependency-free browser game:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js` is an IIFE that owns the game state, canvas rendering, world data, input, combat, companions, progression, audio, and HUD updates. It initializes the world and starts a `requestAnimationFrame` loop (`game.js:6–8, 2228–2249, 3465–3567`).
- **Canvas world plus DOM UI:** The world and minimap use canvases; HUD, menus, prompts, and controls are DOM elements (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:14, 52, 167–175, 308`).
- **Data-driven but tightly coupled content:** Chapters, weapons, enemy types, roles, and shelter definitions are constants in `game.js`; the frame update coordinates player, companions, spawning, enemies, projectiles, and interactions (`game.js:340–355, 488–499, 2238–2248`).

## Findings and likely runtime issues

1. **Chapter progression doesn’t match a seven-night boss cadence.** Progression advances after every **eight** survived nights (`game.js:344, 1296–1297`), and there is no boss definition or boss-specific encounter logic in the game implementation. Adding a chapter entry alone would not add a region: the chapter array currently contains names, while the world and shelter positions remain fixed (`game.js:348–355, 492–511`).

2. **Progression continues after the final chapter.** `advanceChapter()` caps the chapter number at six, but still runs its other transition effects each time it is called (`game.js:1306–1329`). After Chapter VI, every eight nights can therefore repeat Chapter VI messaging, reset shelter haunt, and attempt companion spawning—without actually advancing to a new chapter. Shelter collapse stops once four shelters remain (`game.js:1312–1321`).

3. **Shelters aren’t enterable safe zones.** Interaction claims or moves camp to a shelter; it does not move the player inside or track an “inside” state (`game.js:1428–1501, 1514–1528`). Protection is instead modeled around the active shelter and its barricade/integrity during night defense (`game.js:1206–1224`). If entering a shelter is a requirement, it needs an explicit player-state/geometry mechanic and corresponding enemy behavior.

4. **A chapter transition can strand a traveling companion.** Collapse eligibility excludes the active shelter and shelters with residents, but not a shelter targeted by a companion still traveling there (`game.js:1312–1321`). If that destination collapses, the travel update changes the companion to `wild` (`game.js:2185–2190`). This is an edge case worth handling when transitions and travel overlap.

5. **Touch aiming is automatic rather than directional.** The mobile FIRE control targets the nearest enemy within 900 units while firing; if none is found, the existing aim is retained (`game.js:1084–1098, 1409–1415`). This is a design limitation rather than an obvious crash, but it affects mobile combat expectations.

## Safe extension points

- **Chapters and boss encounters:** Add explicit chapter/region configuration near `CHAPTERS`, then update `beginNextDay()` / `advanceChapter()` to distinguish ordinary transitions from final-night encounters (`game.js:348–355, 1281–1330`). Give boss timing and completion their own state rather than relying only on the capped chapter counter.
- **Shelter entry and protection:** Build on `doInteract()` and `claimShelter()` for entry/exit actions, then integrate player movement and enemy targeting with the new state (`game.js:1485–1528, 1390–1423, 1968 onward`).
- **Shelter-collapse handling:** Before selecting a shelter to collapse, account for companions targeting it; update the companion or destination coherently if a collapse occurs (`game.js:1312–1321, 930–949, 2185–2203`).
- **Mobile controls:** Input behavior is concentrated in `bindInput()` and `updatePlayer()` (`game.js:997–1099, 1390–1423`); the control elements are in `index.html:167–175`, with touch layout and styling in `styles.css:1145–1249, 2027, 2261–2272, 2440`.

This is a static code review; I did not edit files or run the game.
</subagent>

<subagent sessionID="ses_e4e97a220ffeWhihc595rH7i4q" state="completed">
## Architecture summary

The game is a browser-based canvas game whose core logic lives in [`game.js`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js); [`index.html`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html) supplies the canvas, HUD, shelter panel, menus, and touch controls.

- **Startup and loop:** `init()` builds the world, resets run state, binds inputs, sizes the canvas, and starts `requestAnimationFrame(frame)` ([`game.js:3551–3568`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L3551)). `startGame()` resets the run and enters play on Day 1 ([`game.js:1150–1174`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1150)). Each frame updates gameplay according to the current mode, then renders and refreshes the HUD ([`game.js:3518–3545`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L3518)).

- **Day/night and chapters:** `updatePhase()` advances day → dusk → night; surviving the night shows a timed dawn intermission, then `beginNextDay()` starts the next day ([`game.js:1230–1304`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1230), [`game.js:1373–1382`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1373)). Every eight survived nights, `advanceChapter()` raises the chapter, cools shelter haunt, and may collapse an unoccupied shelter ([`game.js:1281–1331`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1281)). Night duration and the initial wave scale with day, chapter, and shelter conditions ([`game.js:1206–1228`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1206)).

- **Shelters and interactions:** `updateInteraction()` selects the nearest useful target and builds a prompt for gathering, recruiting, claiming/camping, or recalling a companion; `doInteract()` dispatches that action ([`game.js:1428–1501`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1428)). `claimShelter()` owns or moves camp and applies haunt warnings; `buyFort()` handles barricade upgrades and repairs ([`game.js:1514–1559`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1514)). Shelter definitions and their perks are data-driven in `SHELTER_DEFS` ([`game.js:492–499`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L492)).

- **Enemies and combat:** `ENEMY_TYPES` holds base enemy stats. `makeEnemy()` applies day/chapter scaling, and `spawnResidentRaids()` plus `updateSpawning()` create companion-targeting raids and regular night waves ([`game.js:485–490`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L485), [`game.js:1822–1903`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1822)). Player and companion shots enter the bullet system; `updateBullets()` detects hits and calls `damageEnemy()`, with kills handled by `killEnemy()` ([`game.js:1712–1808`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1712)). `updateEnemies()` controls enemy targeting and combat; shelter breaches and player damage are handled separately ([`game.js:1905–1932`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1905), [`game.js:1968–1994`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L1968)).

- **Controls and interface:** `bindInput()` maps keyboard movement/actions, mouse aiming and firing, and touch joystick/fire/use controls ([`game.js:997–1099`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L997)). The HTML contains the world and minimap canvases, status and resource HUD, shelter interface, menus, and mobile controls ([`index.html:14–83`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html#L14), [`index.html:167–179`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html#L167)).

## Extension points

For content-only additions, start with the data tables: `CHAPTERS`, `SHELTER_DEFS`, `ENEMY_TYPES`, `ROLES`, `TURRETS`, `BARRIERS`, and `ABILITIES` ([`game.js:348–355`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L348), [`game.js:421–499`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L421)). For new behavior, the clearest hooks are `updatePhase()`, `updateSpawning()`, `updateEnemies()`, `doInteract()`, and the ordered system calls in `update()` ([`game.js:2228–2249`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js#L2228)). Add or change interface elements in `index.html` and connect them through the existing DOM/input handling in `game.js`.
</subagent>

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the requested screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `README.md`; no implementation changes made.
- Identified architecture and extension points for chapter progression, shelter interactions, enemy behavior, and mobile input.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues, including the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
- Implement the requested gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call and confirm the game starts.
2. Implement the requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper; requires `RUNTIME_DIR`.
- `README.md`: Project and run instructions.

## Important Context
- `resetRun()` calls `playerMaxHealth()` at `game.js:834`; no definition was found.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit and advertised ability controls appear unwired.

input.prompt: Inspect current repo, especially game.js/index.html/styles.css, determine precise implementation structure and whether prior summarized issues remain. Report key functions, likely integration points, available test tooling. Do not edit.

## Repository findings

- **Game implementation:** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js) is a dependency-free IIFE. It caches the DOM, manages game state and audio, binds input, advances the game loop, draws to canvas, and updates the HUD.
- **Page and UI:** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html) defines the game canvas, HUD, shelter and companion panels, field kit, touch controls, and menu/pause/dawn/game-over screens. It loads `styles.css` and `game.js` directly.
- **Styling:** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css) contains the visual styles, responsive breakpoints, safe-area variables, and touch-specific layout rules.
- **Gameplay integration points:** `bindInput()` connects keyboard, mouse, pointer/touch, and UI controls. `startGame()` and the phase functions handle run and day/night transitions; `updateInteraction()` / `doInteract()` handle world interactions; `shoot()` / `updateEnemies()` handle combat; companion behavior is split across `recruitCompanion()` and `updateCompanions()`. `frame()` calls update, render, and HUD updates; `init()` builds the world and starts the loop.
- **Persistence/audio:** Best-run and mute preferences use guarded `localStorage` access. Audio is synthesized through Web Audio; there are no external game assets referenced in the inspected entry points.
- **Test tooling:** No `package.json`, project test files, or test-runner configuration were found. [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh) and [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh) delegate to runtime-provided scripts via `RUNTIME_DIR`; they are not project test commands.
- **Repository state:** The working tree was clean. The latest commit shown was `f170015 Save source and v2 conversation for issue #15`.

The earlier context contains no concrete issue summary to compare with the current code, so whether those issues remain is unverified. No files were modified.

## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the requested screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `README.md`; no implementation changes made.
- `git status --short` produced no listed changes during the latest inspection.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues, including the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
- Implement the requested gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call and confirm the game starts.
2. Implement the requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper; requires `RUNTIME_DIR`.
- `README.md`: Project and run instructions.

## Important Context
- `resetRun()` calls `playerMaxHealth()` at `game.js:834`; no definition was found.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit and advertised ability controls appear unwired.
- `start.sh` and `capture.sh` delegate to runtime scripts via `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test tooling was found.
- The latest inspection attempt could not use `rg` because it is unavailable in the environment.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e4e93fd6fffeW16GxuvwOcHm1n" state="completed">
## Confirmed finding: resource nodes can spawn nearly on top of each other

**Location:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:601–641`, especially the spacing check at **line 623** and the later population at **lines 629–641**.

`buildWorld()` clears `resourceNodes`, then checks candidate spacing against that array while generating nodes. But it does not populate `resourceNodes` until after the candidate-generation loops finish. As a result, the check at line 623 never checks candidates against the starter nodes or earlier accepted candidates.

This produces visible overlaps on the fixed-seed map: reproducing the generator yielded **7 node pairs closer than the intended 82-unit spacing**, with the closest pair **18.8 units apart**. Their sprites overlap, and because interaction selects only the nearest eligible node, nearby resources can be harder to distinguish and gather.

**Minimal integration point:** perform spacing checks against a list populated with the starter nodes and each accepted procedural candidate, before converting those entries into `resourceNodes`.

I did not substantiate additional defects in the reviewed reset/startup, day/night, chapter, enemy/combat, shelter, or interaction flows.
</subagent>

input.prompt: Explore index.html/styles.css/game.js UI controls. Identify menu closability/minimize, field kit and pause flows, mobile control implementation/responsive layout. Return exact functions/selectors and issues; do not edit.

content.text:
<subagent sessionID="ses_e4e93fd6affeLdHI5UFOcUMMZF" state="completed">
## Findings

- **Main menu** — [`index.html`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html) defines `#menuScreen` and `#startBtn`. In [`game.js`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js), `startGame()` starts play and calls `hideScreens()`. There is no menu minimize/close control or menu-specific dismissal handler, so the menu is dismissed through **Start Game**.

- **Pause screen** — The markup uses `#pauseBtn`, `#resumeBtn`, `#pauseRestartBtn`, and `#pauseScreen`. `togglePause()` and `resumeGame()` manage `game.mode` and the pause screen. **Escape** and **P** toggle pause; **Enter** resumes.

- **Field kit** — The markup includes `#kitBtn`, `#kitScreen`, `#kitCloseBtn`, and `[data-kit-tab]`. Although `game.js` has kit-related DOM references and state, no handlers or open/close functions were found for the kit button, close button, or tabs. The field-kit flow therefore appears unwired.

- **Touch controls** — `game.js` detects coarse pointers with `matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)')` and adds `body.touch`. `#joystick` pointer events control movement, `#fireBtn` fires, and `#useBtn` calls `doInteract()`. The touch controls do not include a dedicated pause or field-kit control.

## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the requested screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, `README.md`, `capture.sh`, and `Agents.md`; traced startup, progression, enemy, shelter, UI, and touch-control code.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues, including the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
- Implement the requested gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call near `game.js:834`.
2. Implement the requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper; requires `RUNTIME_DIR`.

## Important Context
- No implementation changes have been made.
- `resetRun()` sets `game.maxHealth = 100` and then calls `playerMaxHealth()` at line 834; no definition was found.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit DOM elements exist, but no open/close or tab handlers were found; touch controls have no dedicated pause or field-kit control.
- `buildWorld()` checks resource spacing against `resourceNodes` before populating that array, so procedural nodes can overlap; seed testing found pairs as close as 18.8 units despite the intended 82-unit spacing.

## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the requested screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game logic, UI, styles, README, and project notes; no implementation changes have been made.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues, implement requested gameplay, visual, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
2. Implement gameplay progression, shelter interactions, presentation, menu, and mobile-control improvements.
3. Test desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper; requires `RUNTIME_DIR`.

## Important Context
- `resetRun()` sets `game.maxHealth = 100` and then calls undefined `playerMaxHealth()` at line 834.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit DOM elements exist, but no open/close or tab handlers were found; touch controls have no dedicated pause or field-kit control.
- `buildWorld()` checks resource spacing against `resourceNodes` before populating that array, allowing procedural nodes to overlap; seed testing found pairs as close as 18.8 units despite the intended 82-unit spacing.

2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

## Findings

The game’s main systems are concentrated in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`, with markup in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html` and responsive/touch styling in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`.

### World and map generation
- `game.js:492–511` defines shelter locations and the existing shelter-link network used by the minimap.
- `buildWorld()` at `game.js:539` creates terrain, shelters, and resources. Terrain generation uses a fixed seed.
- **Integration point:** Add map rotation or alternate layouts at the world-definition/build stage. Keep the shelter-link network and minimap data consistent with whichever layout is active.

### Shelter interactions and entry
- `updateInteraction()` at `game.js:1428` chooses the nearby interaction prompt.
- `doInteract()` at `game.js:1485` dispatches the selected action.
- `claimShelter()` at `game.js:1514` handles claiming or moving camp.
- `drawShelter()` at `game.js:2589` renders shelters.
- No separate shelter interior or entry system is evident; shelter defense currently centers on barricades.
- **Integration point:** Extend the interaction dispatch and shelter rendering if the chapter needs shelter-specific behavior. A true interior/entry flow would be a new system rather than an extension of an existing one.

### Enemies and boss encounters
- Enemy definitions are at `game.js:485–490`.
- Type selection, construction, spawning, and resident raids are at `game.js:1813–1877`; night-wave logic is in `updateSpawning()` at `game.js:1879`.

## Objective
- Upgrade Nightfall into a detailed, playable SCP survival game, fix startup/runtime problems, and verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Make menus closable and minimizable; improve maps, shelters, characters, companions, creatures, textures, faces, and bodies.
- Add stronger, varied SCP creatures and shelter entry for protection.
- Add a boss SCP on night seven; defeating it ends the chapter and starts a new chapter in another region, such as Mexico or Japan, with an appropriate map.
- Support mobile-friendly layout and controls; make reasonable assumptions without clarification.
- Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect the screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game architecture and integration points in `game.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css`.
- Confirmed at initial inspection that the repository had no uncommitted changes; no implementation changes have been made.

### Active
- Fix startup/runtime issues and implement requested gameplay, chapter, shelter, interface, visual, and mobile-control improvements.
- Verify desktop/mobile gameplay and chapter progression; capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Define or remove the unresolved `playerMaxHealth()` call in `resetRun()`.
2. Implement chapter-specific maps and a night-seven boss, plus shelter entry/protection and requested interface and mobile improvements.
3. Fix and verify the procedural resource-node spacing issue.
4. Test desktop/mobile play and chapter progression; capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, world generation, shelters, creatures, rendering, input, and chapter progression.
- `index.html`: Game UI, menus, panels, and mobile controls.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper; requires `RUNTIME_DIR`.

## Important Context
- `resetRun()` sets `game.maxHealth = 100` and then calls undefined `playerMaxHealth()` at line 834.
- `CHAPTER_NIGHTS = 8`; `showDawn()` increments `nightsHeld`, `beginNextDay()` advances every eight nights, and `advanceChapter()` currently collapses a shelter rather than replacing the map.
- Six chapter names exist, but there is no dedicated boss; chapter advancement clamps at the last entry.
- Existing enemies are `walker`, `crawler`, `brute`, and `wraith`.
- Field-kit DOM elements exist, but no open/close or tab handlers were found; touch controls have no dedicated pause or field-kit control.
- `buildWorld()` checks resource spacing against `resourceNodes` before populating that array, allowing procedural nodes to overlap; seed testing found pairs as close as 18.8 units despite the intended 82-unit spacing.
